title: 第234章 问此间（完）
content_zh:
阳春三月,碧绿的暖风吹过大地，万物竞发、生机勃勃，河中冰面消融,亦发出些极细微的裂响，仿佛乍破的蝶蛹。
近日踏青游园的人甚多，但鲜少有人会走到这样偏僻幽静的深林里，轻柔至极的窸窣声一响，一黑一白的两道影子，就从曲折的羊肠小径上踏出。
“扶光,卿卿,”黑衣人追在后面,连连告饶，“我知道错了，我不该……”
晏欢见他总算肯赏脸开口,心便大大地放下去了一半,不由心有余悸地嘟哝：“谁知道它是个空心的,忒不经打……”
除去心魔,为众生剪去一个大患，却远不到休息的时候。六千年来,诸世流毒甚多,浊心天残的症状,尸人的祸患，余下的四个锚点……无一不是晏欢留下的烂摊子，需要人着手修补。
时光无法倒流，损害已经造成，不过刘扶光秉持亡羊补牢，为时不晚的信条。三千诸世生灭，修仙者又无惧岁月，早晚有一天，他们能将世界海恢复成原来的模样。
奈何重新封正之后，晏欢不再掌管罪业恶孽，本性却仍然一团混沌，刘扶光说好，他便好；刘扶光说不好，他便不好。随心所欲，其作为大有古老神明的风范。
他们刚刚从第八个锚点出来，那世界的众生狂热追捧世俗财富，连带着星辰亦诞生出了自我意识，贪欲炽盛，本能地囤积一切它认为有价值的事物。他们赶到的时候，恰巧碰到世界灵智在那谋划计策，意图吞并其它世界的核心，并且在见到刘扶光之后，极力要迫他做自己的藏品之一。
晏欢自然大怒，完全不惯着对方，冲过去就将那灵智直接打爆了。不料它都是把东西藏进自己身体里的，一击之下，就像打破了一个快塞爆的扑满罐子，滔天的金沙喷涌而出，当中混合着无数珠玉财宝、珍稀灵物，不仅有活人活兽，甚至还有整座宫殿、楼阁、山水林园什么的，比灭世的大洪水还夸张。
解决锚点只用了几天，收拾残局倒用了整整几个月，刘扶光简直没话说。
“你知道，”斟酌再三，他决定坦白，“封正那日，我对天道做出过承诺。”
他已经紧张起来，盖因他极其痛恨被天意摆布的感觉，不愿叫爱侣也落了把柄在其手中。
“我对它发了道心誓，承诺我一定会好好看着你，叫你把自己闯下的祸端一一收拾干净。”刘扶光叹气，“否则，你以为它会那么轻易放过你？只怕心魔不动手，你便被劈死在那儿了，管你是不是十一龙君和人皇氏的子嗣呢。”
“扶光，你真好。”他抽抽搭搭地道，“我爱你，好爱你、好爱你，我最爱你了……”
几百箩筐的肉麻话，顿时滔滔不绝地倒在刘扶光身上，委实叫他不胜其扰。刘扶光浑身毛毛的发痒，很想用脚尖跳着赶路，把这些黏糊糊的情话从皮肤上抖索下去，但那样晏欢又要翻滚闹腾得更厉害，还是作罢了。
这一路走来，他们经过了许多奇异斑斓的地方，在一个时间与空间的屏障都异常薄弱，频繁发生物体位移、活灵消失的世界，他曾和晏欢短暂逗留过几周，发现了一册古怪的玉简。
“奇了。”刘扶光读取玉简上的内容，先前看见这枚简书时，他只觉上面残余的气息十分玄妙，似乎来自异度时空，因此花钱将其买下，但用神识扫过，里面却并无什么功法秘籍，藏宝地图，而是话本般的章回小说。
晏欢为他煮茶，听见刘扶光说话，便问：“怎么了，上面说的是什么？”
“小故事。”刘扶光讶然道，“说了你肯定不会相信……这些故事讲的，似乎并非于此世界海中。”
刘扶光道：“里面记载着能够在宇宙中穿行的巨大飞船，一船便有一国大小。那里的人不会修行道法，但是可以在星辰中发起战争，即使是手无缚鸡之力的书生，也能用巴掌大的……这上面说‘枪’，但那模样不过一块银铁——也能用这东西，将雷火掷于千里之外的细微物什上。”

刘扶光忍不住笑，这玉简仅容一人神识通过，更别提龙神那样庞然如海的意识，是以他只能给晏欢口述。
“还有呢，生活在地心岩浆里的巨马，上身却是人，你可见过？”他故意问，“半人半蛇的古神，你可见过？”
听到后面，他又惊诧：“何处搅来半人半蛇的古神，莫不是娲与伏羲？！”
刘扶光笑道：“早知你不会相信。华严经说诸佛子，彼诸世界种，于世界海中，各各依住，各各形状，各各体性，各各趣入，各各庄严，各各无差别——你忘了？本就是天外有天的事。”
话是这么说，刘扶光晚上看完那玉简，第二日早上，它便在枕边不翼而飞，仿佛从未存在过，哪怕他花了大力气去找。
兴许它只出现在有缘人面前，一直是这么四处流浪，从不会在某一处永远停留……刘扶光看过释然，也不是非要将其收入囊中，便就此作罢了。
按照原本的路线规划，他们逐渐走过许多地方。刘扶光耗费心血，调配出能够治愈天残之症的药露，每去到一个陌生地点，晏欢便化作原身，行云布雨，下起一场覆盖万物众生的霖泽。除此之外，应对六千年来背负玄日的罪愆，每年当中，会有整三月的时间，晏欢得身负大日，巡游过千百界的每一个角落，直至刑期满。
后面的要求，倒是晏欢主动提出的，因为担心天道还会对刘扶光的誓言钻什么空子，他索性先把事情做到没有余白的地步再说。
至于他们第一次牵手，是在九个锚点全部拔完的时候。二人短暂地陷入“不必忙碌，可以休息一下，剩下的事交给明天后天”的状态，随便找了方小世界闲逛。
天残之症日趋消解，各方生灵都显出逐步繁荣的光景。今次他们去到的地方颇具异域风情，男人皆袒露上身，赤着双足，仅饰以刺绣腰带和宽大纱裤，女人身披薄纱，束腰小衣上插着乳黄色的伽罗花。无论男女老少，掌心和脚心都用花汁染成了红色，倒显得二人是十足的外域来客。
刘扶光觉得很有趣，他们步行去市集，看到商人们都坐在五彩的丝绸毯子上，往面前摆出各式各样的货物。
有蜡染的麻布，手作的刺绣帐幔，琥珀与水晶镶嵌的酒杯，紫色玻璃的耳环，还有裸体造型的奇怪陶壶。卖香料的摊前系着牛角光滑的纯黑色公牛，卖衣帽的地方豢养着叫声嘶哑的孔雀，酒贩头上顶着塔一样巨大的牛皮酒囊，瓶塞上垂着厚厚的流苏，就像他多长了一条打结的粗辫子。
再加上各色水果、神像、牲畜、弯刀与长矛……他从未见过这么多五花八门的事物，如此绚丽地堆在一个地方。
类似这样衣饰开放的地方，民风自然也热烈开放。在大街上走一遭，无人敢觑晏欢的面色，却有一车一车的鲜花纱巾，玲珑小巧的玩意儿，直往刘扶光身上泼倒。
晏欢脸都黑了，他气得火冒三丈，又不能拿这些大胆示爱的凡人怎么样，只好离刘扶光近一些，再贴近一些，以此展示分外薄弱的所有权，以及非常徒劳的占有欲。
可能是热闹欢笑的气氛在烘托，可能是眼前蓬勃的景象使人心情大好，抑或是心血来潮，善心突然发作……无论如何，刘扶光向后瞥了他一眼，不由地叹了口气。
算不上多亲昵，甚至算不得一个正经的牵手，但瞬时间，晏欢只觉五雷轰顶，直劈得他神志昏聩、意识模糊，稀里糊涂地被牵着走出好远，才勉强回过一丝神来。
手拉手，我、扶光拉着我的手……晏欢恍惚地想，我莫不是在做梦罢？
他越想，越觉得这是一场梦，连反握回去的力气都丧失了。连带着，他越想，就越是面红耳赤，脸上火辣辣的，便如被蒸笼盖过，那沸腾的红，直把耳根都彻底熟透。
就算是梦，也是我永远不愿醒来的美梦呀！晏欢在心里哀叹，不过，在梦里大胆一点，应该也是可以的吧？

想到这里，他才勉力从一团浆糊的脑子里分出一点清醒，用尽全身的力气，轻轻回捏住刘扶光的拇指。
“……傻子。”刘扶光咕哝，有点想掩藏自己好笑的表情，但是失败了。
后来，刘扶光还是主动松手了。因为晏欢激动不已，体温亦在持续升高，手心全是汗，跟炉膛没有任何区别，烤得他皮肤燥热，实在有些受不了。
他们第一次亲吻，倒是在更平常一点的情况下。正是那天，晏欢像邀功一样，对刘扶光讲明了他甘愿负日服刑的意向。
说不意外是假的，刘扶光还没想到他会这么做。盯着晏欢看了片刻，一直看到龙神像个内向的小姑娘一样垂下头，刘扶光才冷不丁地问：“那你是想要什么吗？”
饶是脸皮比天还厚，面对如此直白的提问，晏欢还是不好意思了，他支支吾吾地扭捏了半天，才微弱地哼唧了一声。
他原先只盘算着，只要刘扶光高兴，能对他刮目相看，就已经很好了。至于要什么？他还真不知道，也无从去想。
“让你亲一下吧，”他说，“既然你肯补过六千年的时光……那便让你亲一下，如何？”
他瞪大了九颗眼珠子，晕头转向地愣了好一会，方颤声问：“亲、亲哪里都可以吗？”
你还想亲哪里啊？刘扶光十分无语，鉴于诚信为本的原则，他还是点头应允：“……就随你罢。”
晏欢喜得浑身发抖，他似是卡壳了，一寸寸地弯下腰，极其缓慢地凑近爱侣，手指也不住哆嗦。但还没触到衣角，他又顿在原地，紧接着迅速转头，变回原形狂飞了出去。
大喜犹似大悲，找了个没人的地方，晏欢忍不住先痛哭了一场。满天雷霆阵阵，大雨瓢泼，不多时，晏欢哭完了回来，看着他发红的眼睛，刘扶光假装不知道发生了什么事。
总之，在所有锚点粉碎之后，他们还回了一趟东沼。周易惯会看天，先来将刘扶光祝贺了一番。
“真仙多礼了，我已不是至善，又有什么好庆祝的？”刘扶光笑着道。
周易装模作样道：“啊呀，确实。自上次一别，仙君已是判若两人，脱胎换骨，连客套话也学会啦！”
晏欢向来对仙人没什么好说的，十年怕井绳，周易也不敢见他，因此只有刘扶光来招待他。寒暄过后，周易再三酝酿，审慎地说出了自己的目的：“仙君，我今日前来，自是受人所托，有点琐事，打算告知于你……”
周易道：“仙君估计早就忘了，其实你还有笔外债，始终不曾收回。”
刘扶光苦笑道：“什么债？我欠出去的良多，他人欠我亦是良多，收不收回的，也就那样吧。”
周易回答：“酆都可自成一界，仙人又怎可未有一界容身？从前龙神太危险，仙界始终隐藏在世界海中，不敢叫他知晓，既然现在，仙君肯看顾着他，不许他在造杀业，这个消息才敢透露出来。”
“当日，因为仙君的缘故，至恶并未主动前去捕杀月下老人，他因此逃得一命，这个债，仙君是否要收了？月下老人托我来告，只要仙君首肯，他愿再牵红线，为二位连结姻缘。”

他送别周易，回到寝殿。晏欢正坐立难安，见他进来，立即追问：“他说什么了？没有骚扰为难你吧？”
晏欢顿了顿，想说“是”，可随即想到周易的做为，是他参通天意，救下扶光，自己则欠了比天还大的情。为了这个恩情，仙人自创的一界，他不是也当做空气，没有去破坏吗？
无论如何，也不能打杀了对方——嗯，奇怪，这种感觉，还真是奇怪啊。
刘扶光轻嗤了声，想了想，终究什么也没说，只问：“想不想去仙界走一遭？前提是你要乖乖的，不能在那闹事。”
晏欢顿时了然：“原来说的是他们自己搞的小世界啊。可以呀，我全听卿卿的。”
“我当然知道。再次封正之后，我就能感觉到那界的气息了。”晏欢耸耸肩，“不过，我没理。”
说是仙界，其实与通常的小世界并无多大的差别，人们忙忙碌碌，照样是由凡夫俗子、城池庙宇构建而成的。
两人掩着气息，并不惊扰这界的百姓。晏欢还不知道刘扶光来这里的目的，问：“卿卿，我们干什么去？”
刘扶光打个哈哈，随便含糊了他。照着周易给自己的路引地图，他们来到月下老人的领地，但见城池中央，一棵参天巨木耸立，却是开花正盛的紫薇树。
那满头满枝的繁茂银花，微风拂过时，便如月光辉映、大雪飘散。树枝上更系着无数朱红如丹砂的纤长丝绦，仿佛红线万根，网罗千千结。
刘扶光驻足凝望，晏欢只当他是为美景所迷，跟着他看了好一阵。大街上人头攒动，多是成双入对，无比亲密的男男女女。
“你在这里等我。”找到了目标，刘扶光吩咐道，“我一会就回来。”
他只身走进一家客栈，柜台后，头发雪白的老人眯着眼睛，正在书页上写写划划。
“来啦？”老人头也不抬，用手中玉笔搔搔额角，“客人要打尖还是住店啊？”
“是了，确实不能打尖，也不能住店。我这里呀，只招待手指头上拴着线的客人。”他笑眯眯地说。
听见他的话，他下意识抬起手，发现小指上赫然出现一截断裂的红痕，犹如触目惊心的伤疤，始终不肯消褪颜色。
“如何呢？”老人耸动花白的眉毛，挤眉弄眼，不住起劲地怂恿，“我看客人你与我有缘，要不要再来一根？价钱从优、老少咸宜，走过路过不可错过呀客人！”
人流来来去去，经过龙神的时候，皆不由自主地辟出一个空间，将他独自留在那儿，而晏欢恍若未觉，只是一心一意地注视自己，他的眼神纯粹又热忱，容不下任何多余的事物。
刘扶光偏过脑袋，一瞬之间，他的记忆里闪现过许多东西。有时候，他也会产生别样的好奇心，譬如晏欢有没有在哪个地方给他建了座神殿。
“还是算了吧。”沉思片刻，刘扶光开口道，“没这个必要，反正栓住我们的东西，已经比红线复杂太多，也顽固太多了。”

月下老人不置可否，他做出撅嘴的顽童神态，刘扶光微微一笑，离开客栈，朝晏欢走过去。
两人肩并着肩，过了片刻，晏欢悄悄伸手过来，用自己的小指头，勾住了刘扶光的小指头。
刘扶光没低头看，亦没有甩开他。他抽出小拇指，重新换成十指相扣的手势，便继续往前走了。

周易回答：“酆都可自成一界，仙人又怎可未有一界容身？从前龙神太危险，仙界始终隐藏在世界海中，不敢叫他知晓，既然现在，仙君肯看顾着他，不许他在造杀业，这个消息才敢透露出来。”
“当日，因为仙君的缘故，至恶并未主动前去捕杀月下老人，他因此逃得一命，这个债，仙君是否要收了？月下老人托我来告，只要仙君首肯，他愿再牵红线，为二位连结姻缘。”
他送别周易，回到寝殿。晏欢正坐立难安，见他进来，立即追问：“他说什么了？没有骚扰为难你吧？”
晏欢顿了顿，想说“是”，可随即想到周易的做为，是他参通天意，救下扶光，自己则欠了比天还大的情。为了这个恩情，仙人自创的一界，他不是也当做空气，没有去破坏吗？
无论如何，也不能打杀了对方——嗯，奇怪，这种感觉，还真是奇怪啊。
刘扶光轻嗤了声，想了想，终究什么也没说，只问：“想不想去仙界走一遭？前提是你要乖乖的，不能在那闹事。”

晏欢顿时了然：“原来说的是他们自己搞的小世界啊。可以呀，我全听卿卿的。”
“我当然知道。再次封正之后，我就能感觉到那界的气息了。”晏欢耸耸肩，“不过，我没理。”
说是仙界，其实与通常的小世界并无多大的差别，人们忙忙碌碌，照样是由凡夫俗子、城池庙宇构建而成的。
两人掩着气息，并不惊扰这界的百姓。晏欢还不知道刘扶光来这里的目的，问：“卿卿，我们干什么去？”
刘扶光打个哈哈，随便含糊了他。照着周易给自己的路引地图，他们来到月下老人的领地，但见城池中央，一棵参天巨木耸立，却是开花正盛的紫薇树。
那满头满枝的繁茂银花，微风拂过时，便如月光辉映、大雪飘散。树枝上更系着无数朱红如丹砂的纤长丝绦，仿佛红线万根，网罗千千结。
刘扶光驻足凝望，晏欢只当他是为美景所迷，跟着他看了好一阵。大街上人头攒动，多是成双入对，无比亲密的男男女女。
“你在这里等我。”找到了目标，刘扶光吩咐道，“我一会就回来。”
他只身走进一家客栈，柜台后，头发雪白的老人眯着眼睛，正在书页上写写划划。
“来啦？”老人头也不抬，用手中玉笔搔搔额角，“客人要打尖还是住店啊？”
“是了，确实不能打尖，也不能住店。我这里呀，只招待手指头上拴着线的客人。”他笑眯眯地说。
听见他的话，他下意识抬起手，发现小指上赫然出现一截断裂的红痕，犹如触目惊心的伤疤，始终不肯消褪颜色。
“如何呢？”老人耸动花白的眉毛，挤眉弄眼，不住起劲地怂恿，“我看客人你与我有缘，要不要再来一根？价钱从优、老少咸宜，走过路过不可错过呀客人！”
人流来来去去，经过龙神的时候，皆不由自主地辟出一个空间，将他独自留在那儿，而晏欢恍若未觉，只是一心一意地注视自己，他的眼神纯粹又热忱，容不下任何多余的事物。
刘扶光偏过脑袋，一瞬之间，他的记忆里闪现过许多东西。有时候，他也会产生别样的好奇心，譬如晏欢有没有在哪个地方给他建了座神殿。
“还是算了吧。”沉思片刻，刘扶光开口道，“没这个必要，反正栓住我们的东西，已经比红线复杂太多，也顽固太多了。”
月下老人不置可否，他做出撅嘴的顽童神态，刘扶光微微一笑，离开客栈，朝晏欢走过去。
两人肩并着肩，过了片刻，晏欢悄悄伸手过来，用自己的小指头，勾住了刘扶光的小指头。
刘扶光没低头看，亦没有甩开他。他抽出小拇指，重新换成十指相扣的手势，便继续往前走了。

In the spring of March, the green warm wind blows across the earth, and everything is vigorous and vigorous. The ice in the river melts, and there are also some very subtle cracking sounds, like a newly broken chrysalis.
There have been many people outing and visiting the park recently, but few of them have gone to such a remote and quiet deep forest. As soon as a soft rustling sound was heard, two shadows, one black and one white, stepped out from the winding path.
"Fuguang, Qingqing," the man in black chased after him, begging for mercy again and again, "I know I was wrong, I shouldn't..."
Seeing that he was finally willing to speak up, Yan Huan felt relieved and could not help but murmur with lingering fear: "Who knew it was hollow, so it couldn't survive a beating..."
Get rid of inner demons and cut off a big trouble for all sentient beings, but it is far from the time to rest. In the past six thousand years, there have been many poisons in the world, the symptoms of the turbid heart, the scourge of corpses, and the remaining four anchor points... all are messes left by Yan Huan and need to be repaired.
We cannot turn back time and the damage has been done, but Liu Fuguang adheres to the belief that it is not too late to make amends. Three thousand worlds have come and gone, and immortal cultivators are not afraid of time. Sooner or later, they will be able to restore the world sea to its original appearance.
However, after being reinstated, Yan Huan was no longer in charge of sins and evil, but his nature was still chaotic. If Liu Fuguang said it was good, he would be good; if Liu Fuguang said it was not good, he would be bad. He does as he pleases, and his actions are like those of the ancient gods.
They had just come out of the eighth anchor point. The sentient beings in that world were fanatically pursuing worldly wealth, and even the stars were born with self-awareness. They were greedy and instinctively hoarded everything they considered valuable. When they arrived, they happened to encounter World Spirit making plans there, intending to annex the cores of other worlds. After meeting Liu Fuguang, they tried their best to force him to become one of their collections.
Yan Huan was naturally furious. He didn't tolerate the other party at all. He rushed over and blew up the spirit. Unexpectedly, it hid things in its own body. With one blow, it was like breaking a filled jar that was about to burst. A torrential amount of golden sand spurted out, mixed with countless jewels, treasures, rare spiritual objects, not only living people and animals, but even entire palaces, pavilions, landscapes and gardens. It was even more exaggerated than the great flood that destroyed the world.
It only took a few days to resolve the anchor point, but a full few months to clean up the mess. Liu Fuguang was speechless.
"You know," after careful consideration, he decided to confess, "I made a promise to the way of heaven on the day I was enshrined."
He was already nervous because he hated the feeling of being manipulated by God's will and did not want his lover to fall into his hands.
"I swore an oath to it, promising that I would watch you carefully and ask you to clean up all the troubles you caused." Liu Fuguang sighed, "Otherwise, do you think it will let you go so easily? I'm afraid that if the inner demon doesn't do anything, you will be hacked to death there, regardless of whether you are the descendant of the Eleventh Dragon Lord and the Human Emperor Clan."
"Fuguang, you're so kind." He said coaxingly, "I love you, love you so much, love you so much, I love you the most..."
Hundreds of baskets of disgusting words suddenly poured out on Liu Fuguang, which really disturbed him. Liu Fuguang felt itchy all over his body and wanted to jump on his toes to shake these sticky love words from his skin, but Yan Huan would make the tumbling and fuss even more, so he gave up.
Along the way, they passed many strange and beautiful places. In a world where the barriers between time and space are extremely weak, objects frequently shift, and living things disappear. He once stayed briefly with Yan Huan for a few weeks and discovered a strange jade slip.
"It's strange." Liu Fuguang read the contents on the jade slip. When he saw the slip before, he felt that the remaining aura on it was very mysterious, as if it came from another time and space, so he spent money to buy it. However, when he scanned it with his spiritual consciousness, he found that there were no secret books or treasure maps in it, but insteadA story-like chapter novel.
Yan Huan made tea for him. When he heard Liu Fuguang talking, he asked, "What's wrong? What does it say?"
"Little stories." Liu Fuguang said in surprise, "You won't believe it if you tell me...it seems that these stories are not told in this world sea."
Liu Fuguang said: "It contains records of huge spaceships that can travel through the universe. One ship is as big as a country. The people there do not practice Taoism, but they can start wars in the stars. Even a scholar with no strength can use a palm-sized... It says 'gun', but it looks like nothing more than a piece of silver and iron - you can also use this thing to throw thunder and fire at tiny objects thousands of miles away."
Liu Fuguang couldn't help but laugh. This jade slip could only allow one person's consciousness to pass through, let alone a consciousness as vast as the dragon god's, so he could only dictate it to Yan Huan.
"Also, have you seen the giant horse that lives in the magma at the center of the earth, but has a human upper body?" He asked deliberately, "Have you ever seen the ancient god who is half human and half snake?"
Hearing what happened next, he was surprised again: "Where did the half-human, half-snake ancient gods come from? Could it be Wa and Fuxi?!"
Liu Fuguang laughed and said, "I knew you wouldn't believe it. The Avatamsaka Sutra says that all Buddhas and world species live in the sea of the world, each with its own shape, each with its own nature, each with its own interest, each with its own solemnity, and each with no difference - have you forgotten? This is a matter of heaven outside the sky."
That is to say, after Liu Fuguang read the jade slip at night, it disappeared from his pillow the next morning, as if it had never existed, even though he spent great efforts to find it.
Maybe it only appears in front of destined people, and has always been wandering around, never staying in one place forever... Liu Fuguang saw Ji Ran, and he didn't insist on keeping it in his pocket, so he just gave up.
According to the original route plan, they gradually passed through many places. Liu Fuguang worked hard to prepare a medicinal dew that could cure the disease of the disabled. Whenever he went to a strange place, Yan Huan would transform into his original body, move the clouds and spread rain, and create a rain that covered all living things. In addition, in order to deal with the sin of carrying Xuan Ri for six thousand years, Yan Huan would have to carry the sun for three months every year, traveling to every corner of Qianbai Realm until the sentence was over.
The latter request was made by Yan Huan on his own initiative. Because he was worried that Heaven would take advantage of Liu Fuguang's oath, he simply made sure that there was no room for error.
As for the first time they held hands, it was when all nine anchor points were pulled out. The two of them briefly fell into the state of "no need to be busy, can take a rest, leave the rest to tomorrow and the day after tomorrow", and casually found Fang Xiaojie to hang out.
The disease of natural disability is gradually disappearing, and all living beings are gradually prospering. The place they went to this time was quite exotic. The men were all topless and barefooted, only decorated with embroidered belts and loose gauze trousers. The women were wearing tulle, with cream-yellow gala flowers on their waist-tunics. Regardless of whether they were men, women, old or young, their palms and soles were dyed red with flower juice, making them look like visitors from a foreign land.
Liu Fuguang found it very interesting. They walked to the market and saw merchants sitting on colorful silk blankets and placing various goods in front of them.
There are batik linen, hand-embroidered curtains, wine glasses inlaid with amber and crystal, earrings made of purple glass, and strange clay pots in the shape of nudes. A pure black bull with smooth horns was tied in front of the spice stall, a peacock with a hoarse cry was raised in the clothes and hat stall, and the wine seller carried a huge cowhide wine bag as big as a tower on his head, with thick tassels hanging from the bottle cork, as if he had an extra thick knotted braid.
Plus all kinds of fruits, idols, livestock, scimitars and spears... He had never seen so many kinds of things, piled up in one place so beautifully.
In a place where clothing and clothing are open like this, the folk customs are naturally warm and open. Walking on the street, no one dares to look at Yan HuanDespite his complexion, there were carts and carts of flower gauze and exquisite little things, all poured directly on Liu Fuguang.
Yan Huan's face turned dark, he was furious, and he couldn't do anything to these mortals who boldly showed their love, so he had to get closer to Liu Fuguang, and even closer, to show his extremely weak ownership and very futile possessiveness.
Maybe it was the lively and laughing atmosphere, maybe it was the vigorous scene in front of him that made people feel good, or maybe it was a sudden burst of kindness... In any case, Liu Fuguang glanced back at him and sighed involuntarily.
It wasn't much intimacy, not even a serious hand-holding, but in an instant, Yan Huan felt like five thunderbolts struck him, making him dizzy and confused. He was led for a long distance in a daze before he finally regained consciousness.
Hand in hand, I, Fuguang held my hand... Yan Huan thought in a daze, could I be dreaming?
The more he thought about it, the more he felt it was a dream, and he even lost the strength to hold it back. Along with this, the more he thought about it, the redder his face became. His face was as hot as if it were covered by a steamer, and the boiling redness made his ears completely cooked.
Even if it is a dream, it is a sweet dream that I never want to wake up from! Yan Huan lamented in his heart, but it should be okay to be bolder in his dreams, right?
Thinking of this, he managed to get some clarity out of his mushy mind, and used all his strength to gently squeeze Liu Fuguang's thumb back.
"...Idiot." Liu Fuguang muttered, trying to hide his funny expression, but failed.
Later, Liu Fuguang took the initiative to let go. Because Yan Huan was so excited, his body temperature continued to rise, and his palms were covered in sweat, which was no different from the furnace. The heat on his skin made him unbearable.
The first time they kissed, it was under more normal circumstances. It was on that day that Yan Huan made it clear to Liu Fuguang that he was willing to serve his sentence at the end of the day, as if asking for credit.
It would be a lie to say that he was not surprised. Liu Fuguang had not thought that he would do this. After staring at Yan Huan for a while, until he saw the Dragon God lowering his head like an introverted little girl, Liu Fuguang asked coldly: "Then what do you want?"
Even though he was thick-skinned, Yan Huan was still embarrassed to face such a straightforward question. He hesitated for a long time before letting out a weak groan.
He originally only planned that as long as Liu Fuguang was happy and could look at him with admiration, that would be great. As for what you want? He really didn't know and couldn't think about it.
"Let me give you a kiss," he said. "Since you are willing to make up for the six thousand years... let me give you a kiss, how about it?"
His eyes widened and he was stunned for a long time. Then he asked in a trembling voice: "Is it okay to kiss anywhere?"
Where else do you want to kiss? Liu Fuguang was speechless. In view of the principle of honesty, he nodded in agreement: "...it's up to you."
Yan Huan was trembling with joy. He seemed to be stuck. He bent down inch by inch and moved closer to his lover extremely slowly, his fingers trembling. But before he touched the corner of his clothes, he paused on the spot again, then quickly turned his head, changed back to his original form and flew out wildly.
He was as happy as he was sad. He found a place where no one was around, and Yan Huan couldn't help crying. The sky was thundering and the rain was pouring. Not long after, Yan Huan came back from crying. Looking at his red eyes, Liu Fuguang pretended not to know what happened.
Anyway, after all the anchor points were shattered, they made a trip back to the East Marsh. Zhou Yi was accustomed to looking at the sky, so he came to congratulate Liu Fuguang first.
"The real immortal is so polite, but I am no longer the best, so what is there to celebrate?" Liu Fuguang said with a smile.
Zhou Yi pretended to say: "Ah, indeed. Since the last time we said goodbye, the Immortal Lord has become a completely different person. He has even learned to speak politely!"
Yan Huan has always had nothing good to say about immortals. He was afraid of well ropes for ten years, and even Zhou Yi did not dareTo see him, only Liu Fuguang came to entertain him. After the greetings, Zhou Yi pondered again and again, and carefully stated his purpose: "Immortal Lord, I came today because I was entrusted by someone, and I have some trivial matters, and I plan to tell you..."
Zhou Yi said: "The Immortal Lord has probably forgotten it a long time ago. In fact, you still have a foreign debt that has never been recovered."
Liu Fuguang smiled bitterly and said: "What debt? I owe a lot, and others owe me a lot. If I can't collect it, so be it."
Zhou Yi replied: "Fengdu can be a world of its own, so how can the immortals not have a place in their own world? In the past, the Dragon God was too dangerous, and the immortal world was always hidden in the sea of the world, so I didn't dare to let him know about it. Now that the immortal king is willing to watch over him and not allow him to commit murderous deeds, I dare to reveal this news."
"On that day, because of the Immortal Lord, the most evil one did not take the initiative to hunt and kill Old Man Yuexia, so he escaped with his life. Does the Immortal Lord want to collect this debt? Old Man Yuexia asked me to sue. As long as the Immortal Lord agrees, he is willing to hold the red thread again and connect the two of you in marriage."
He bid farewell to Zhou Yi and returned to his dormitory. Yan Huan was sitting uneasy. Seeing him come in, he immediately asked, "What did he say? He wasn't harassing you, was he?"
Yan Huan paused and wanted to say "yes", but then he thought of Zhou Yi's actions. He understood God's will and saved Fuguang, but he owed a debt greater than the sky. For this kindness, didn't he regard the world created by the immortal as nothing but air and not destroy it?
No matter what, you can't kill the opponent - well, strange, this feeling is really strange.
Liu Fuguang sneered slightly, thought for a while, and finally said nothing. He just asked: "Do you want to go to the fairy world? The prerequisite is that you must be good and not make trouble there."
Yan Huan suddenly understood: "It turns out that they are talking about their own little world. That's okay, I will listen to Qingqing."
"Of course I know. After being sealed again, I can feel the breath of that world." Yan Huan shrugged, "But, I ignored it."
Although it is said to be a fairy world, it is actually not much different from an ordinary small world. People are busy and it is still built from ordinary people, cities and temples.
The two of them concealed their breath and did not disturb the people in this world. Yan Huan still didn't know the purpose of Liu Fuguang's coming here, so he asked: "Qingqing, what are we going to do?"
Liu Fuguang laughed and vaguely confused him. Following the road guide map given to them by Zhou Yi, they came to the territory of Old Man Yuexia, but saw a towering giant tree standing in the center of the city, but it was a crape myrtle tree in full bloom.
The lush silver flowers on the head and branches, when the breeze blows, they shine like the moonlight and the heavy snow drifts away. The branches are tied with countless slender silk ribbons as red as cinnabar, as if there are thousands of red threads and thousands of knots in the net.
Liu Fuguang stopped and stared. Yan Huan just thought he was fascinated by the beautiful scenery and followed him for a while. The streets are crowded with people, mostly men and women who are in pairs and extremely intimate.
"Wait for me here." After finding the target, Liu Fuguang ordered, "I'll be back in a minute."
He walked into an inn alone. Behind the counter, an old man with white hair squinted his eyes and was writing on the page of a book.
"Here you are?" The old man scratched his forehead with the jade pen in his hand without raising his head, "Does the guest want to be tipped or stay in the hotel?"
"Yes, it is true that you can't make a tip, and you can't stay in a hotel. Here, I only entertain customers with strings tied to their fingers." He said with a smile.
Hearing his words, he subconsciously raised his hand and found a broken red mark on his little finger, like a shocking scar that never faded away.
"How about it?" The old man raised his gray eyebrows, winked, and kept encouraging, "I think you are destined for me, guest. Do you want another one? The price is favorable, and it is suitable for all ages. Don't miss it when you pass by!"
People came and went, and when they passed the Dragon God, they all involuntarily created a space, leaving him alone there, and Yan HuanAs if he didn't realize it, he just stared at himself wholeheartedly. His eyes were pure and passionate, and could not tolerate anything superfluous.
Liu Fuguang turned his head. In an instant, many things flashed through his memory. Sometimes, he would also have other curiosity, such as whether Yan Huan built a temple for him somewhere.
"Let's forget it." After thinking for a moment, Liu Fuguang said, "It's not necessary. Anyway, the things that tie us down are already much more complicated and stubborn than the red thread."
The old man under the moon was noncommittal, and he acted like a pouty naughty boy. Liu Fuguang smiled slightly, left the inn, and walked towards Yan Huan.
The two of them were side by side. After a while, Yan Huan quietly reached out and hooked Liu Fuguang's little finger with his little finger.
Liu Fuguang didn't look down or shake him off. He took out his little finger, changed it to the interlocking gesture again, and continued to move forward.

People came and went, and when they passed by the Dragon God, they all involuntarily created a space, leaving him alone there, but Yan Huan seemed unaware and just stared at himself wholeheartedly. His eyes were pure and enthusiastic, and could not tolerate anything superfluous.
Liu Fuguang turned his head. In an instant, many things flashed through his memory. Sometimes, he would also have other curiosity, such as whether Yan Huan built a temple for him somewhere.
"Let's forget it." After thinking for a moment, Liu Fuguang said, "It's not necessary. Anyway, the things that tie us down are already much more complicated and stubborn than the red thread."
The old man under the moon was noncommittal, and he acted like a pouty naughty boy. Liu Fuguang smiled slightly, left the inn, and walked towards Yan Huan.
The two were side by side. After a moment, Yan Huan quietly reached out and hooked Liu Fuguang's little finger with his own.
Liu Fuguang didn't look down or shake him off. He took out his little finger, changed it to the interlocking gesture again, and continued to move forward.
